Mr. Jeffrey Epstein

11.06.2013

Dear Mr. Epstein,
It is my honor and pleasure to invite you to attend the eleventh commencement of the Faculty of Liberal
Arts and Sciences of St. Petersburg State University. The FLAS SPSU, a joint partnership of St.
Petersburg State University and Bard College, New York, is the first department in Russia to be founded
upon the principles of liberal arts.
The commencement will be held at the Assembly Hall of St. Petersburg University (Universitetskaya
emb., 7/9) at 3:30 p.m. on Saturday, June 22s . The ceremony will be followed by a graduation ball at
the Bobrinsky Palace (Galernaya st., 58 — 60) at 7:00 p.m.
I am also delighted to invite you to a lunch that we are hosting for the members of the Board of Overseers,
Russian and international partners of the FLAS SPSU at 1:00 p.m., right before the graduation ceremony.
The draft program of commencement events is attached.
We would appreciate if you could confirm your participation in these events by sending a message to
Natalia Alyoshina, Development Officer (alyoshina@smolny.org). We will be glad to assist you in every
possible way.
We look forward to seeing you in St. Petersburg in June.
Sincerely,
Valery Monakhov

Vice Chair of the Academic Council
Faculty of Liberal Arts and Sciences
St. Petersburg State University
